stem: Quick check — Sensitive data best practices including Vault; ephemeral values and write-only arguments. Which practice is correct?

choices.text: Ignore least privilege and use the root user for speed
Leave hourly resources running overnight without teardown
Treat budget alerts as a hard spend stop that deletes resources
Apply the objective directly: Sensitive data best practices including Vault; ephemeral values and write-only arguments

rationale: Option A aligns with the published objective wording. B violates root/MFA guidance. C ignores teardown. D misstates AWS Budgets behavior (alerts do not stop spend).
